segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ חוֹטְמוֹ שֶׁנִּיקַּב, וְשֶׁנִּפְגַּם, וְשֶׁנִּסְדַּק. שְׂפָמוֹ שֶׁנִּיקְּבָה, שֶׁנִּפְגְּמָה, שֶׁנִּסְדְּקָה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» For these additional blemishes, one may slaughter a firstborn animal outside the Temple: «Its nose that was pierced, or that was damaged» and is lacking, «or that was split.» Likewise, «its lip that was pierced,» or «that was damaged,» or «that was split» is considered a blemish.

moves.summary: nose or lip pierced, damaged or split

positions.claim: a pierced, damaged or split nose or lip is a blemish
